# Task ID: 6
# Title: Dynamic Subtitle System
# Status: pending
# Dependencies: 5 (Not found)
# Priority: high
# Description: Implement auto-generated captions with timing synchronization and multiple caption styles
# Details:
Priority: P0 (MVP Critical)

Functional Requirements:
- Auto-generated captions with timing synchronization
- Multiple caption styles (pop, standard, minimal)
- Emoji integration support
- Color and animation customization (paid tiers)

Technical Specifications:
- Speech-to-text processing via Whisper AI
- Caption timing accuracy within 100ms
- Unicode emoji support
- CSS-based animation system

Free Tier Limitations:
- 2 caption styles available
- Fixed color scheme
- Basic animations only

Acceptance Criteria:
- Captions accurately reflect spoken content
- Timing synchronization maintains readability
- Emoji integration works seamlessly
- Style changes apply instantly in preview

# Test Strategy:
Unit tests for caption generation, integration tests for timing
